text: Sara has an office job in a large office building in the city centre. She goes to the office by bus every morning, and her office hours are from nine to five. She works for a bank manager, who has a lot of meetings, so she answers the phone and writes his emails. In the same company, there is a shop manager who looks after a chain of small shops. Sara's friend works as a personal secretary for the manager of a hotel. At first, Sara thought that an office worker had an easy life, but after a few weeks she changed her mind. There are always new tasks, and some days she works late. She also learned that the most important thing is good communication. "A secretary," she says, "must know everything and say very little." Now she is learning Chinese, because her bank wants to work with new customers abroad.

title: A Visit to the Museum
text: Last weekend, our class visited a history museum in the capital. A museum guide met us at the entrance and told us about an exhibition in the museum that is called "Life in the Past". We saw old clothes, tools and coins from hundreds of years ago. After the museum, we went to an art gallery next door. A famous painting in the art gallery was so big that it took up the whole wall. In the evening, some of us decided to go to the cinema, while others preferred to go to the theatre. The cinema ticket was cheap, but it was difficult to book theatre tickets for the same night because the theatre was full. At last, the group agreed to go to the cinema together. It was a long day, but we learned a lot, and our teacher said that she was proud of us.
